content.ENG: Thus far, every program we have written has been executed line by line in order...

description.ENG: Print 'Orwell' if the number is exactly 1984.
description.CAS: Imprime 'Orwell' si el número es exactamente 1984.

description.ENG: Write a program that prints absolute value of integer.
description.CAS: Escribe un programa que imprima el valor absoluto de un entero.
description.EUS: Idatzi zenbaki oso baten balio absolutua inprimatzen duen programa.

description.ENG: Ask name. If not Jerry, ask portions and print cost.
description.CAS: Pide nombre. Si no es Jerry, pide porciones e imprime costo.
description.EUS: Eskatu izena. Jerry ez bada, eskatu zatiak eta inprimatu kostua.

description.ENG: Ask for two numbers and operation (add, subtract, multiply).
description.CAS: Pide dos números y operación (add, subtract, multiply).
description.EUS: Eskatu bi zenbaki eta eragiketa (add, subtract, multiply).

description.ENG: Convert F to C. If < 0, print Brr.
description.CAS: Convierte F a C. Si < 0, imprime Brr.
description.EUS: Bihurtu F C-ra. < 0 bada, inprimatu Brr.

description.CAS: Arregla la lógica del cálculo del bono.

initialCode.ENG:
points = int(input('Points: '))
if points < 100:
    points *= 1.1
    print('Bonus 10%')
if points >= 100:
    points *= 1.15
    print('Bonus 15%')
